measurement.rss: simultaneous sum of benchmark process-tree RSS, including pool/resource tracker and sampling subprocess; may double-count shared pages
measurement.scratch: peak logical file bytes and file count inside the owned annotation workspace; reference snapshots excluded
measurement.timed: prepare_annotation_sources only; includes worker startup, shutdown, and diagnostic merging; excludes input generation and post-run comparisons
measurement.native_pools: PyArrow CPU and I/O pools each limited to 1 in parent and worker processes
measurement.repetition: Fresh processes, sequential runs, no cold-cache control. Initial real-serial-1 characterizes phases; real serial medians use 2-4. Three runs per process worker count and per wide serial baseline. Thread screens once per count after they showed no worthwhile gain.

wide.description: Eight synthetic chromosome shards, 6000 logical rows each, 8 baseline and 1000 query columns
wide.formula: For zero-based row i and within-source column j: ((7*i+j)%41-20)/8; the first rsID is shared across all eight chromosomes.
